notes: Built from the Start Romagna "Libretto Inverno 25-26 RA" PDF (212pp; the cooptrasportiriolo.it copy is Cloudflare-walled so the mirror on startromagna.it was used). Extracted with pdftotext -layout. Coop Trasporti Riolo Terme is the vector explicitly marked "◆ COOP. TRASPORTI RIOLO TERME ◆" for: urban lines 55 (Gialla) and 56 (Verde), plus extraurbane 189, 195, 196, 197, 198, 199. Built the 6 core Riolo-hub lines (55, 56, 195, 196, 197, 198); omitted 189 (Tredozio-Forlì) and 199 (S.Martino-Imola) which are peripheral to the Riolo urban+extraurban scope. Each route has a representative trip in both directions with exact clock times copied from the timetable columns; stop sequences are the published stop order. route_type=3 (bus) for all. Stops geocoded via OSM Nominatim (WGS-84): town/locality centroids for Casola Valsenio, Isola, Borgo Rivola, Valsenio, Cuffiano, Campiano, Villa Vezzano, Zattaglia, Brisighella, Faenza, Lugo, Imola, etc. The Start Romagna 'Fermate RA' open dataset and OSM highway=bus_stop Overpass query returned no named nodes for these rural Senio-valley stops, so ~15 minor urban/street stops (via Ripa, via Manzoni, Isola Parcheggio, Borgo Rivola v.Pilastrino/Pastore, Castel Bolognese FS/Z.Ind., Misileo) carry approximate coordinates interpolated within the correct locality (not null, but ±200-500m) — these are the main confidence deduction. Calendar: SCHOOL (Mon-Fri, school days; lines 55/56/196/197/198 run "SI EFFETTUA NEI GIORNI DI SCUOLA") and DAILY (Mon-Sun; line 195 "GIORNALIERO"), dated to the winter 2025-26 booklet period. Note: many trips in the source are marked "a richiesta" (on-request) and have school-day/Saturday exception footnotes not modeled as calendar_dates.
